Help manual

Getting started

Run Setup, import tracks, and open Tours or Tutorials.

On this page
  • Setup
  • Rekordbox
  • Tracks directory
  • Tours
  • Tutorials

Setup

  1. Install manaDJ using the install guide; follow its Setup steps for accounts and audio.
  2. On first launch, choose Get started. Every step is optional.
  3. Finish later saves progress. Resume under Settings → Help → Setup, or choose Run setup again.

Rekordbox

  1. Open Rekordbox import, review the collection, then Import new tracks. Keep my genres imports genres as Tags.
  2. If nothing appears, open Rekordbox and Look again. Reconnect missing music drives. Keep manaDJ open during import.

Tracks directory

  1. Choose folder…, then Save & scan folder. In a browser, paste the full path. Use folder without scanning saves only the location.

Audio stays in place; existing tracks are skipped. After a connection error, use Check progress.

Tours

  1. Open ? → Tours — look around to locate controls.

Tutorials

  1. Choose ? → Tutorials — learn by doing; perform each requested action. Tutorial Library edits are real. Replay under Settings → Help → Tutorials.
